Thousands gather at Jaipur temple for wedding-wish mehndi

Thousands of unmarried individuals gathered at the Moti Dungri Ganesh Temple in Jaipur, seeking mehndi (henna) believed to grant marriage wishes. Police were deployed to manage the large crowd. Approximately 3,500 kilograms of mehndi were distributed and reportedly finished within three hours. The event saw a massive turnout, with many unmarried people participating.
